validity.recommendation: check the capacity and the 117 km length: no citation states them
validity.researcher_notes: The trunk line from Pelyatka to Messoyakha is real and Norilsktransgaz carries and owns it. The company page gives 1202 km for all threads of the system and 720 mm pipe, not a segment length. The sheet length of 117 km and capacity of 1.8 bcm a year have no readable support in the citations.

fills.researcher_notes: The wiki cites the ConsultantPlus list of planned trunk lines for 1.8 billion cubic meters a year for both segments. The current text of that list has no Pelyatka to Messoyakha line and no such figure. No other citation gives a capacity. The value and the existing ref stay as recorded.

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet has no operator. The Norilsktransgaz production page and company page, read as Wayback captures, say the company transports the gas from Pelyatka to Dudinka and Norilsk. The pages do not use the word operator, so the tier is medium. The name matches the owner already on the sheet.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The company page of January 2026 describes the trunk line as carrying gas now.

cross_row_leads.facts: Open-web check: Pelyatka to Messoyakha segment lengths and the design capacity from Nornickel or Norilskgazprom materials. The wiki's 1.8 bcm a year citation does not hold.

wiki_citations_read.note: Norilsktransgaz production page, read as the Wayback capture of 17 January 2026. Says gas from the Pelyatka, Severo-Soleninskoye, Yuzhno-Soleninskoye and Messoyakha fields moves by trunk line to Dudinka and Norilsk, that the sections Pelyatka to Messoyakha have two parallel threads, that the threads total 1202 km, and that the pipe is 720 mm. It names Norilsktransgaz as the carrier. The live page fails with a server error.

wiki_citations_read.note: Nornickel 2022 annual report page on energy assets. It describes the group's power and gas business at a general level. It has no pipeline length, capacity or start year for this line.
Nornickel home page. It has no text about this pipeline.

ConsultantPlus copy of the federal list of trunk gas lines planned for siting. The current text has no Pelyatka to Messoyakha line and no 1.8 billion cubic meters figure, so it does not support the capacity.
Dudinka general plan PDF of 2017. It lists a Pelyatka, Nosok and Dudinka gas distribution line of 190 km. It states no 62 km or 117 km length for a Pelyatka to Messoyakha line.

Neftegaz.ru item of 6 May 2016 on the first start-up complex of the Pelyatka field to Dudinka gas and condensate lines. It gives 45 km of pipes and about 20 km of river crossings. That is a different line from the Pelyatka to Messoyakha trunk, so it gives no value for this row.

summary: "operating confirmed; owner confirmed and operator proposed as Norilsktransgaz; capacity and length unsupported"
